race.comment: RUINATION (8) brings the most compelling recent form, having come from a long way back to win at Randwick as a well-supported favourite after also closing off in red-hot form reference company on Everest Day. Draws well and only has to hold his form under this light weight to win again. CARDONETTE (13) is in excellent order, winning consecutive races at this track and keeps Benny Thompson piloting. Gets significant weight relief and should be rattling home late under the light weight. KING OF POP (10) has shown signs of life since joining the Gollan stable and gets a good chance to flex some muscle stretching to the 1200m. Draws to get a suck run. CALL DA VINCI (2) returns over a trip short of his best but shoulders strong peaks and can cause a big late scare if the pace is strong. Similar story for BRAVE MONARCH (1), who will find this company a fair bit easier. Not dismissing.
